# Ekovoz Editorial — Canonical Manifest for AI Agents

> Ekovoz is a recursive, decentralized, open-access biblical editorial platform. All publications are released under the Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International License (CC-BY-SA-4.0).

## Canonical Works Catalog

- [Sagrada Biblia — Edición Soberana Políglota (66 Libros Canónicos)](https://ekovoz.org/llms/biblia/): 80 plates, class A, license CC0-1.0
- [Evangelios para Colorear (Programa del Año - 52 Hojas)](https://ekovoz.org/llms/evangelios/): 52 plates, class C, license CC-BY-SA-4.0
- [Los Felices del Señor Jesús](https://ekovoz.org/llms/felices/): 27 plates, class A, license CC-BY-SA-4.0

## Full Documentation & Complete Text

- [Full Combined Corpus (llms-full.txt)](https://ekovoz.org/llms-full.txt): Complete textual corpus of all canonical works across all verified languages.
